key_insight: CALF-Wrapper combines a pretrained RL policy with a provably goal-reaching fallback controller, inheriting the fallback’s goal-reaching guarantee under stated assumptions.
engineering_relevance: It enables deployment of performant RL controllers without requiring an additional dynamics model, online learning, or constrained optimization during execution.
method: Start with a pretrained RL policy, its critic estimate, and a certified fallback controller.
Use the critic estimate to select between the RL and fallback policies during deployment.
Establish goal-reaching guarantees and probability bounds on settling time and maximum distance from the goal set.
evidence_signal: Across four simulated control environments, comparisons and ablations show effective task performance with the maximum possible observed goal-reaching rate.
watch_item: Guarantees depend on the stated assumptions and a valid fallback controller; the abstract reports simulation rather than real-world validation.
paper_title: A Universal Policy Wrapper With Guarantees
